items.headline: US nearing deal with Russia to free multiple jailed Americans: Sources
items.detail: Sources say the talks have centered on freeing Stephen Hubbard.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: Couple charged in fatal shooting of 17-year-old on her way to zoo
items.detail: A husband and wife from Texas have been arrested and charged in the killing of a 17-year-old who was shot on Interstate 170 last week.

items.headline: Man arrested for alleged threats to shoot President Trump at Kansas rally
items.detail: Authorities allege the man posted several threatening messages on Facebook.

items.headline: WATCH: Funding cuts forcing World Food Program to reduce lifesaving aid in Gaza
items.detail: ABC News' Ian Pannell reports on the state of the agency, which says it's been providing food to around 1.6 million people every month since last year's ceasefire announcement.
